newsitem.title: USA: Clinton says Chelsea has not decided on Harvard.
newsitem.headline: Clinton says Chelsea has not decided on Harvard.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Thursday said his daughter Chelsea has not decided where she will go to college next year after reports surfaced that Harvard has offered her admission.
"She has literally made no decisions yet," Clinton told reporters. "And I think, you know, most of the announcements come out in the springtime. She hasn't made any decision yet."
Harvard University officials declined to comment on a Los Angeles Times report that the Ivy league school had offered admission to Chelsea, who turns 17 on Feb. 27.

"Harvard's policy is to make no comment on such matters," Alex Huppe, a university spokesman, said. "It is strictly a matter between the school and the applicant. It is a private matter and we will not comment."
The president's daughter visited Brown University in Providence, Rhode Island, and Yale University in New Haven, Connecticut, as well as Harvard, on a tour of Ivy League campuses last autumn.
